links.outcome: GPT-4 accuracy and completeness interpreting AAOS and Chinese osteoarthritis guidelines
links.effect: Correct match rate 46.4%; accuracy score 4.3±1.6 (95% CI 3.9 to 4.7); completeness 2.8±0.6; complete agreement with all score-2 recommendations.
links.quote: In interpreting the American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons and Chinese OA guidelines, GPT-4 achieved a correct match rate of 46.4% and complete agreement with all score-2 recommendations.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of GPT-4's performance on clinical guideline interpretation and simulated orthopaedic cases evaluated by orthopaedic specialists.
